source: two REAL_ROOT brains registered internally (task0043-seed-proof.py); one click on Actualiser for the baseline, then every change is made by the harness on disk, outside the process, with NO click: external changes, a burst, the whole root moved away and put back, a second brain; then a REAL close, the source changed while the application is closed, a REAL relaunch with nobody clicking; the outcome of each IPC is read from the Tauri-Response header on the wire (CDP Network), every state from the real badges and panels, and every backend watcher event is recorded from the page and checked for the closed envelope
developmentCadences: FILETOPO_WATCH_GUARD_MS=500, COALESCE_MS=150, CALM_MS=150 (development build only; the product defaults are 5 s / 300 ms / 300 ms)
limits: No personal brain: the analysed trees were generated by task0043-seed-proof.py and die with the proof root
Filesystem changes are made by the harness with Node, in-process to the harness and outside FileTopo; a real user editor may batch or delay notifications differently

The relaunch races the page load: the initial verification of a few thousand entries can finish before the page attaches, so the ordering claim "the Index equals the disk before any stable state" is proved by the Rust engine test that captures the Index inside the notifier at the instant WATCHING is announced, and here by the state at the first WATCHING the page could see (initialVerificationObservedLiveOnScreen says whether the transition itself was seen)

The 5 s / 30 s product cadences are not waited for here: the development overrides shorten the root guard and the coalescing windows; the periodic fallback is proved by the Rust engine (a backend that declares itself unsupported), not by this run, which uses the native mechanism
The volume is a local NTFS disk of a development workstation: a network share, a FAT volume, a cloud-synced folder and USN are not exercised
Development workstation; not a modest-laptop acceptance test
